streamtakeover.summary: Boolean flag (empty/1/true); lets a publisher reclaim its in-use stream ID using a browser-stored signed takeover key.

altlabel.summary: Text string (underscores become spaces); replaces the translated 'enter display name' prompt text.

auth.summary: Flag; loads the SSO auth client and hides the main menu and header until sign-in completes; aliases supply tokens or require auth.

mutestatus.summary: Boolean flag; shows a muted-state icon on remote guest videos in a room.

unmutestatus.summary: Boolean flag; shows an unmuted-state icon on remote guest videos in a room.

feedbackbutton.summary: Optional numeric volume percent; unhides the 'hear yourself' self-monitor button and sets its playback volume.

retrytimeout.summary: Numeric ms (minimum 5000, default 5000); delay before re-requesting a lost stream.

testmedia.summary: Mode string (1/on, audio/mic/a, video/cam/v; 0/false/off disables); replaces capture with synthetic test media.

testaudio.summary: Boolean (0/false/off/no disables); with testmedia, toggles the synthetic audio track.

testvideo.summary: Boolean (0/false/off/no disables); with testmedia, toggles the synthetic video track.

testfps.summary: Numeric fps (1-60); frame rate of synthetic test video, only with testmedia.

testwidth.summary: Numeric px (160-3840); width of synthetic test video, only with testmedia.

testheight.summary: Numeric px (120-2160); height of synthetic test video, only with testmedia.

testtone.summary: Numeric Hz (50-2000, default 440); tone frequency of synthetic test audio, only with testmedia.

pendingicettl.summary: Numeric ms (3000-60000, default 15000); how long queued pending ICE candidates are kept before expiry.

scenemutebutton.summary: Boolean flag; shows a guest button that mutes outbound audio to scene peers while still talking in the room.

userbackgroundimage.summary: Image URL or data URI (default backgrounds/1.png); background image behind each video tile in the layout mixer.

userforegroundimage.summary: Image URL or data URI (default avatar1.png); overlay image placed over each video tile in the layout mixer.

avatarimg2.summary: Image URL (default avatar2.png); CSS video background shown while talking; enables audio effects and meter style 4.

avatarimg3.summary: Image URL (default avatar3.png); CSS video background shown while screaming (loud); enables audio effects and meter style 4.

noaudiowhipin.summary: Boolean flag; strips audio from the SDP of incoming WHIP publishers (e.g. OBS).

novideowhipin.summary: Boolean flag; strips video from the SDP of incoming WHIP publishers (e.g. OBS).

autoreload.summary: Numeric minutes (default 60); repeatedly calls hangup with reload at that interval.

autoreload24.summary: HH:MM 24-hour local time; calls hangup with reload once at that time (next day if passed).

endpage.summary: URL (sanitized); redirect target after hang-up; changes hang-up text to 'Redirecting shortly'.

endpagetimer.summary: Numeric ms (default 3000 via endpage); delay before the endpage redirect; only read when endpage is set.

autoend.summary: Numeric ms (default 600000); shows a fixed countdown overlay and hangs up when it expires.

whepwait.summary: Numeric ms (default 2000, minimum 0); ICE-gathering wait for WHEP connections.

whipwait.summary: Numeric ms (default 2000, minimum 0); ICE-gathering wait for WHIP connections.

whipme.summary: Boolean flag; removes the hidden class from the WIP 'Join Room via WHIP' menu card, whose inline display:none still applies.

whippushtoken.summary: Token string; bearer token for whippush output; empty value unhides the token input field.

whipoutkeyframe.summary: Numeric ms; after a WHIP-out connection starts, forces a video keyframe (PLI) after that delay.

whipoutkeyframenewviewer.summary: Unclear from code: sets session.whipOutKeyframeOnNewViewer, referenced only in comments.

whepplay.summary: WHEP URL (URI-decoded); plays that WHEP stream about 1 s after load.

whepplaytoken.summary: Token string; bearer token used for whepplay WHEP playback.

nomouseevents.summary: Boolean flag; disables mouse and touch handlers on videos, including mini-preview dragging and tap stats menus.

overlaycontrols.summary: Boolean flag; layout stops reserving height for the control bar so it overlays the video.

pusheffectsdata.summary: Boolean flag; posts face-mesh effect keypoint coordinates to the parent page via the IFRAME API.

pushloudness.summary: Boolean flag; enables loudness output over the IFRAME API.

meshcast2.summary: Mode string (any/anon/audio/video, default any); publishes through Meshcast v2 with server discovery.

whipfallback.summary: Boolean flag; viewer advertises and accepts a Meshcast/WHEP fallback handoff; ignored when nomeshcast is set.

chunkcast.summary: Boolean flag; sends chunked-recorder media frames out over a websocket instead of real-time chunk paths.

discordwebhook.summary: Discord webhook URL or path; posts an alert when an incoming stream disconnects and does not reconnect within 60 s.

discordwebhook2.summary: Discord webhook URL or path; like discordwebhook but also alerts on intentional hang-ups.

drawing.summary: Boolean (0/false/off disables); renders incoming drawing annotations as canvas overlays on remote videos.

drawingrelay.summary: Boolean (default on; 0/false/off disables); relays a viewer's drawings to other peers allowed to draw.

nodrawingrelay.summary: Boolean flag; turns off relaying drawings between peers.

nohistory.summary: Boolean flag; stops pushing rewritten URLs into browser history (default on inside iframes).

history.summary: Boolean flag; re-enables browser history URL updates, overriding the iframe default.

pagezoom.summary: Boolean flag; adds a fixed 100-400% zoom slider that scales the grid layout and allows pinch zoom.

callin.summary: Mode string (default sip); loads callin.js, a phone call-in panel using SIP or Twilio.

fulltalk.summary: 6-character room code; connects to the PSTN call websocket to talk and hear all.

justtalk.summary: 6-character room code; joins the Twilio PSTN conference to talk only.

hearptsn.summary: 6-character room code; listens to PSTN call audio over websocket only.

updateonslotschange.summary: Boolean flag (false/0/off disables); rebuilds and reapplies the layout when slot assignments change.

leaveorientationflag.summary: Boolean flag; keeps the video-orientation extmap line in SDP instead of stripping it.

pausepreview.summary: Boolean flag; sets director preview bitrate to 0 and marks the first quality button pressed.

forceviewerlandscape.summary: Numeric degrees (default 270); rotates incoming portrait videos to display landscape.

forceviewerportrait.summary: Numeric degrees (default 90); rotates incoming landscape videos to display portrait.

nofullscreenbutton.summary: Boolean flag; hides the per-video full-window button on room guest tiles.

socialstream.summary: Unclear from code: sets session.socialstream (string), which no code reads.

tc.summary: Optional value; parses incoming MIDI timecode and shows it as an on-screen 'Timecode' overlay message.

nochunkediframestats.summary: Boolean flag; stops posting chunked-outbound frame events to the IFRAME API.

midiiframe.summary: Boolean flag; forwards received MIDI messages to the parent page as IFRAME API midi-in events.

ptt.summary: Hotkey string (e.g. ctrl+m); sets the push-to-talk hotkey; empty value opens a hotkey selection prompt.

framegrabaudio.summary: Boolean (empty on; 0/false/no/off off); with framegrab, enables audio capture for the published frame source.

audio.summary: Alias for framegrabaudio in framegrab mode when framegrabaudio is absent; same boolean values.

ssstyle.summary: Numeric style (default 1); auto-layout for screen shares, spotlighting the share; 2 puts others in a left column.

alignright.summary: Boolean (0/false/no/off disables); right-aligns the spotlighted screen share, using screen-share layout style 2.

surfaceswitching.summary: String include/exclude (default exclude); passes surfaceSwitching to the screen-capture request.

recordwindow.summary: Optional bitrate kbps (default 6000); captures the current tab and records it to disk, with clean output.

locksize.summary: Unclear from code: sets session.lockWindowSize, which no code reads.

nocontrolbarspace.summary: Boolean flag; stops the layout reserving dedicated space for the control bar.

ignorehighlight.summary: Boolean flag; ignores the director's infocus (highlight) messages.

pauseinvisible.summary: Boolean flag; videos hidden by the scene layout are muted and throttled to the hidden-scene bitrate.

zoomslider.summary: Boolean flag; adds a remote camera zoom slider on guest videos for directors or remote-control viewers.

ptzslider.summary: Boolean flag; adds pan/tilt/zoom slider controls on guest videos for directors or remote-control viewers.

viewslot.summary: Numeric slot number; shows only the guest in that room slot full-frame and plays only layout audio.

exclusivelayoutaudio.summary: Non-empty value; with a layout active, drops streams outside the layout from the mix and throttles them.

inclusivelayoutaudio.summary: Non-empty value; keeps streams outside the active layout in the mix (turns exclusive layout audio off).

muteall.summary: Boolean flag; shows the director's 'mute all guests' toggle button.

gdriveall.summary: Boolean flag; shows the director's 'Google Drive record all guests' toggle button.

tipsid.summary: Overlay token string; enables receiving tips; empty value opens the tip onboarding modal.

receivetips.summary: Boolean flag; enables receiving tips and opens the onboarding modal when no tipsid is set.

tipserver.summary: URL; tip backend server (default ninjabacker.com) for tip pages and notifications.

tipamounts.summary: Comma list of positive integers (default 5,10,25,50,100); tip amounts sent to viewers for tip buttons.

tipcurrency.summary: Currency code (uppercased, default USD); currency sent to viewers for tipping.

showtips.summary: Boolean flag; viewer opts in to see tip icons on videos of performers accepting tips.

tipqrsize.summary: Numeric px (minimum 100, default 150); size of the tip QR code; setting it forces the QR to show.

notipqr.summary: Boolean flag; disables the tip QR code shown in OBS or scene/view links.

crop.summary: Numeric percent; forces a camera aspect-ratio constraint scaled from 16:9 (negative divides, 0 gives 4:3).

fit.summary: Boolean flag; sets CSS fit-style to fit and sizes the local video to full viewport.

splitrecording.summary: Numeric minutes (default 5); splits local recordings into segments of that length.

recordfolder.summary: Folder name string; Google Drive folder used for recordings.

menuoffset.summary: CSS length (default 50px); sets the bottom offset of the control bar and makes it absolutely positioned.

rows.summary: Comma list of row counts indexed by guest count; auto layout arranges tiles into that many rows (negative centers a partial last row).

publish.summary: Boolean flag; enables studio publish mode, showing the publish settings panel and the local record button (ignored in record-window mode).

morescenes.summary: Numeric scene count (default 16, minimum 8); sets session.maxScene and adds extra scene buttons S9 to SN to guest controls.

joinscene.summary: Comma list of scene names; guest asks to auto-join those scenes, which only works if the target has &openscene.

openscene.summary: Boolean flag; lets this scene or director accept guests' &joinscene requests and add them to the requested scenes.

fakeuser.summary: Boolean flag; joins data-only with autostart, no video, audio or iframe playback, and clean output.

pseudoguest.summary: Boolean flag; auto-joins without camera or mic, hides main menu, header, control buttons and mini taskbar, and flags itself as pseudoguest.

autochannels.summary: Comma list of audio channels 1-8 (default 1,2,3,5,6,7,8); director auto-assigns joining guests to those audio channels.

autochannelmode.summary: String mode for director audio-channel auto-assignment: roundrobin or rr, otherwise leastused.

preferchannel.summary: Numeric audio channel 1-8; guest's preferred channel, sent to the director for auto-assignment.

nohiddensceneoptimization.summary: Boolean flag; disables the reduced bitrate for hidden scenes, unless &hiddenscenebitrate is set.

cccolored.summary: Boolean flag; colors each speaker's closed-caption text with a color derived from their ID.

sessionlog.summary: Boolean flag; enables session logging, shows the session marker button, and downloads the session log on hangup.

sessionlogtranscript.summary: Boolean flag; adds final transcript lines to the session log (needs &sessionlog).

nopassword.summary: Boolean flag; disables the room password, including the default password.

salt.summary: String; custom salt combined with the password when generating room and director hashes.

showmeta.summary: Boolean flag; shows guests' shared meta fields in their video labels.

resources.summary: Comma list or boolean flag; accepts incoming resource data channels from peers and advertises the allowed resource types.

meta.summary: Comma list of field ids 1-9; prompts the guest for profile fields (pronouns, title, socials, bio, location, avatar, QR) and shares them.

slider.summary: Boolean flag; always shows the outbound video bitrate slider in the connection stats menu, even in rooms.

lowlatency.summary: Boolean flag; turns off audio processing, FEC, buffers, sync and WebAudio, sets 10ms ptime and CBR; also disables the guest audio meter.

fec.summary: Boolean flag read only by &lowlatency; its presence keeps FEC enabled instead of disabling it.

audiobuffer.summary: Numeric ms; receiver audio jitter buffer target; its presence also stops &lowlatency zeroing it.

ap.summary: Boolean flag read only by &lowlatency; its presence keeps the WebAudio processing pipeline and audio meter enabled.

noheadphones.summary: Boolean flag; forces echo cancellation, auto gain and noise suppression on, and voice isolation on unless already set.

isolation.summary: Boolean-ish value (false, 0, no, off disable); sets the mic voice isolation constraint.

translate.summary: Language code or boolean flag; loads the live translation controller and its UI, starting translation as owner.

translationprovider.summary: String provider name for live translation (default openai, or localStorage value); used with &translate.

translateaudio.summary: String mode replace, duck or mix (default replace) for translated audio; used with &translate.

translationbroker.summary: URL of the translation broker service; used with &translate.

waitpage.summary: URL; shows that page as a full-screen iframe layout until a layout takes over (needs iframes allowed).

waitice.summary: Boolean flag; waits for ICE candidate gathering to complete before sending SDP.

directorview.summary: Boolean flag; joins as director without trying to claim the room.

graphs.summary: Boolean flag; enables stats graphs, including the director's scene stats graphs.

minroombitrate.summary: Numeric kbps; floor applied to the room and scene total-bitrate caps.

weightedroombitrate.summary: Boolean value (default on; 0, false, off, no disable); gives larger camera tiles a larger share of the room video budget.

micpanning.summary: Numeric 0-180 (default 90, center); downmixes the mic to mono and pans it, adding a panning control to audio settings.

highlightmute.summary: Boolean-ish value; highlighting a guest unmutes them and remotely mutes the others; presets the matching checkbox.

noobsstream.summary: Boolean flag; initializes the reported OBS streaming state to false.

noobsvirtual.summary: Boolean flag; initializes the reported OBS virtual camera state to false.

noobsrecord.summary: Boolean flag; initializes the reported OBS recording state to false.

noobssourceactive.summary: Boolean flag; initializes the reported OBS source-active state to false.

noobsvisibility.summary: Boolean flag; initializes the reported OBS visibility state to false.

aligntop.summary: Boolean flag; injects CSS that pins video holders to the top of the page.

retry.summary: Numeric seconds (default 30); forces a retry of watching the requested view streams after that delay.

dropbox.summary: String Dropbox token; loads the Dropbox SDK for saving recordings to Dropbox.

gdrive.summary: Boolean flag; enables the Google Drive uploader for recordings.

whitemode.summary: Boolean flag; applies the whitetheme body class and turns dark mode off.

androidfix.summary: Boolean flag; enables the Android H.264 profile SDP rewrite when an h264profile is set.

blackout.summary: Boolean flag; shows the blackout mode button; with a value, starts blackout mode immediately.

noscreenshare.summary: Boolean flag; disables playback of screen shares.

screenp2p.summary: Boolean flag; prefers peer-to-peer over WHEP for incoming screen shares.

screenwheponly.summary: Boolean flag; prefers WHEP only for incoming screen shares.

screenwhep.summary: Boolean-ish value; true prefers WHEP, false prefers peer-to-peer, for incoming screen shares.

allowscreenvideo.summary: Boolean-ish value (default true); overrides whether screen share video is requested.

allowscreenaudio.summary: Boolean-ish value (default true); overrides whether screen share audio is requested.

excludeaudio.summary: Comma list of stream IDs, including screen variants, whose audio playback is excluded.

videoonly.summary: Boolean flag; disables audio playback for all streams.

youtube.summary: String "clientID,APIkey"; stores YouTube credentials for the YouTube chat interface.

cbr.summary: Boolean flag; uses constant bitrate encoding and hides the WHIP-out VBR/CBR option.

slotreserve.summary: Boolean value (0 or false disables); enables slot reservations, marked in the slot picker.

reservedslots.summary: JSON object mapping slot numbers to stream IDs; preassigns reserved slots and enables reservations.

maxslots.summary: Numeric slot count (default 20); number of slots listed in the slot picker.

alpha.summary: Boolean flag; keeps the alpha channel in canvas contexts and WebCodecs encoder configs.

viewchroma.summary: Hex color (default 0f0); chroma-keys incoming video on non-director viewers.

viewchromahide.summary: Boolean value (default on; 0, false, off disable); hides the unkeyed source video under &viewchroma.

chunkedbuffer.summary: Numeric ms (default 5000 when given, 500 otherwise); chunked-mode sender buffer window.

chunkprofile.summary: Preset name mobile, balanced or desktop; applies a bundle of chunked-mode FEC, NACK, buffer and adaptation settings.

chunkcodec.summary: String codec name; WebCodecs encoder preference for chunked mode, separate from &codec.

fixedchunkbuffer.summary: Boolean flag; disables the adaptive chunked-mode receive buffer.

chunkadapt.summary: String mode bitrate, framerate or hybrid; chunked-mode encoder adaptation strategy.

nochunkaudio.summary: Boolean flag; tells senders this viewer won't receive chunked audio.

debug.summary: Boolean-ish value; turns on debug logging, only on vdo.ninja hosts.

webxrbridge.summary: Boolean flag; enables the external sensor bridge that accepts sensor data via postMessage.

sensorsorigin.summary: Origin string; only accepts external sensor bridge messages from this origin (with &webxrbridge).

vred.summary: Boolean flag; adds video RED/FEC when preferring the requested codec in received SDP.

pvred.summary: Boolean flag; adds video RED/FEC when the publisher prefers a video codec.

redaudio.summary: Boolean flag; experimental RED audio when applying the viewer's requested audio codec.

fecaudio.summary: Boolean flag; experimental audio FEC when applying the viewer's requested audio codec.

predaudio.summary: Boolean flag; RED audio when the publisher or WHIP output prefers an audio codec.

pfecaudio.summary: Boolean flag; audio FEC when the publisher or WHIP output prefers an audio codec.

preferaudiocodec.summary: String codec name; publisher-side preferred audio codec applied to outgoing connections.

prefervideocodec.summary: String codec name; publisher-side preferred video codec applied to outgoing connections.

scenelinkcodec.summary: String codec name; appends &codec= to generated scene links and disables the codec selector.

scenelinkbitrate.summary: Numeric kbps; appends &totalbitrate= to generated scene links.

nonacks.summary: Boolean flag; strips NACK feedback from received SDP.

nopli.summary: Boolean flag; strips PLI feedback from received SDP.

noremb.summary: Boolean flag; strips REMB bandwidth feedback from received SDP.

poke.summary: String topic or boolean flag; triggers a push notification on join, to that topic or a room-derived one.

custombeep.summary: Audio URL; replaces the notification beep sound.

customleave.summary: Audio URL; replaces the guest-leave sound.

customjoin.summary: Audio URL; replaces the guest-join sound.

beepvolume.summary: Numeric percent; volume of the beep, join and leave sounds.

welcomehtml.summary: Base64 or URL-encoded HTML (sanitized, max 8192); shown as the welcome message.

mixminus.summary: Boolean flag; sends each peer a mix-minus of other audio; on director or co-director, builds a custom mix per guest.

roomtier1bitrate.summary: Numeric kbps; overrides the mobile guest bitrate cap used at room-only tier 1 (default 1500).

roomtier2bitrate.summary: Numeric kbps; overrides the mobile guest bitrate cap used at room-only tier 2 and above (default 2000).

whipoutaudiocodec.summary: String codec name (e.g. opus, pcm, red); sets the preferred audio codec in WHIP output SDP.

fullhd.summary: Boolean flag; sets publish quality preset 0 (1080p) and removes the screen and webcam quality gear options.

4k.summary: Boolean flag; sets publish quality preset -2 (2160p) and removes the screen and webcam quality gear options.

nostats.summary: Boolean flag; disables the stats menu and hides its Show Stats context-menu entry.

showheader.summary: Boolean flag; forces the page header and head2 visible (display, opacity, hidden class removed).

nocontrolbar.summary: Boolean flag; hides the controlButtons bar and removes its reserved layout space.

degrade.summary: String (maintain-framerate, maintain-resolution, balanced) or flag; viewer asks the publisher to use this degradationPreference.

rtpprofile.summary: String talkinghead or irl; enables publisher-side opt-in RTP camera adaptation with that profile.

roomcap.summary: Positive integer; participant cap sent with the director's room claim.

roomkey.summary: String (sanitized); room bypass key sent on join, used as claim bypass key and appended to generated links.

noclaim.summary: Boolean flag; stops a director page from auto-claiming the room.

claim.summary: Value 0/false/off/no disables director room auto-claim; other values change nothing.

requireencryption.summary: Boolean flag; requires encrypted signaling messages and rejects ones without an encryption vector.

unsafe.summary: Boolean flag; with a custom password, allows sending and accepting unencrypted signaling messages.

audiodelay.summary: Numeric ms (max 179000); adds a fixed Web Audio delay to incoming audio.

mirroroutput.summary: Boolean-ish (0/false/off disables); permanently mirrors the published output (sets permaMirrored).

flipoutput.summary: Boolean-ish (0/false/off disables); flips published output vertically and sets session.flipped, injecting video scaleY(-1) CSS.

lanonly.summary: Boolean flag; restricts ICE to local-network candidates and clears STUN/TURN configuration.

stunonly.summary: Boolean flag; filters SDP and ICE to STUN candidates only, no TURN relay.

ipv6.summary: 0/false drops IPv6 candidates when IPv4 exists; 1/true allows normal dual-stack without IPv4 preference.

preferipv4.summary: Boolean flag; drops IPv6 candidates when IPv4 candidates exist.

activehighlight.summary: Value 1 or 2 (0/false off); auto-focuses the loudest speaker as infocus (1) or infocus2 (2) in the layout.

activespeakerdelay.summary: Numeric ms (default 3000); delay before the active-speaker layout switches.

fadeout.summary: Optional numeric ms (default 500); fades out departing videos instead of removing them, sets --fadeout-speed CSS.

widgetleft.summary: Boolean flag; places the &widget iframe on the left and shifts the play area right.

widgetwidth.summary: Numeric percent (default 25, max 50); sets widget iframe width via the --widget-width CSS variable.

insertablestreams.summary: Flag or string; enables encodedInsertableStreams in the RTCPeerConnection configuration.

outboundsamplerate.summary: Numeric Hz; sample rate for the outbound AudioContext.

micsamplerate.summary: Numeric Hz (default 48000); requested microphone sampleRate constraint.

micsamplesize.summary: Numeric bits (default 16); requested microphone sampleSize constraint.

iframetarget.summary: String origin (default own origin, or * on file:); target origin for postMessage to the parent frame.

sendframes.summary: Optional string; when embedded in an iframe, posts incoming video frames to the parent window.

bundle.summary: String (default max-bundle); sets the RTCPeerConnection bundlePolicy.

planb.summary: Boolean flag; switches SDP semantics to legacy plan-b.

apiserver.summary: WebSocket URL; overrides the remote API server (default wss://api.vdo.ninja:443).

speedtest.summary: Flag or TURN locale string; speed-test mode: filters TURN servers, caps bitrate at 6000 kbps, sets queue type 4.

approvepopup.summary: Boolean flag (director only); shows approval popups for pending join requests.

requireapproval.summary: Boolean flag; room claim requires server-side approval before guests join.

hostwhep.summary: String stream ID (defaults to own stream ID); publishes via the WHEP host client (whepOut).

whipnoscreen.summary: Boolean flag; excludes screen share from WHIP output.

whipprimaryonly.summary: Boolean flag; WHIP output publishes only the primary camera, not screen share.

whipscreenonly.summary: Boolean flag; WHIP output publishes only the screen share, not the primary camera.

mediamtx.summary: String host or URL (defaults .com and :8889); builds MediaMTX WHIP/WHEP endpoints from the stream ID.

mediamtxnoscreen.summary: Boolean flag (with &mediamtx); excludes screen share from MediaMTX publishing.

mediamtxscreenonly.summary: Boolean flag (with &mediamtx); publishes only the screen share to MediaMTX.

meshcastnoscreen.summary: Boolean flag; excludes screen share from Meshcast/WHIP publishing.

meshcastscreenonly.summary: Boolean flag; Meshcast/WHIP publishes only the screen share.

meshcastprimaryonly.summary: Boolean flag; Meshcast/WHIP publishes only the primary camera.

hideeffectscontrols.summary: Boolean flag; adds hide-effects-controls class, hiding effect selector panels without disabling the effect.

digitalzoom.summary: Optional numeric zoom (default 1); enables the digital zoom video effect (effect 7).

backgroundblur.summary: Optional numeric strength (default 2); enables the background blur effect (effect 3).

virtualbackground.summary: Boolean flag; selects video effect 5 (virtual background).

transparentbg.summary: Boolean flag; selects video effect 16 (transparent background).

facemesh.summary: Boolean flag; selects video effect 6 (face mesh).

facecrop.summary: Boolean flag; selects the facecrop video effect.

chromakey.summary: Optional numeric value (default 25); selects chroma key video effect 14.

chromakeybg.summary: Optional numeric value (default 25); selects chroma key background video effect 15.

facetracker.summary: Boolean flag; selects video effect 1 (face tracking).

overlayfx.summary: Boolean flag; selects the overlay video effect.

anonymousmask.summary: Boolean flag; selects the anon mask video effect.

dogface.summary: Boolean flag; selects the dog face video effect.

zoom.summary: Numeric zoom level; requests camera zoom and enables PTZ handling.

focus.summary: Numeric; sets a manual camera focusDistance constraint.

wss.summary: Optional host/URL (wss:// prefixed); sets a custom signaling websocket server.

wss2.summary: Host/URL (wss:// prefixed); overrides the signaling websocket without setting the customWSS flag.

audience.summary: String ID; connects to audience.vdo.ninja listen (viewer) or publish websocket for that audience.

scenewss2.summary: Host/URL; websocket put in director-generated scene links, active on scene pages when wss/wss2 unset.

invitecammanaged.summary: Value 1; invite.cam manages room assignment, restricting room migrations and transfers.

invitecam.summary: String room.view-token; invite.cam shorthand that sets scene-page WSS and is kept in generated scene links.

bypass.summary: Flag or value; routes signaling through iframe parent postMessage instead of a websocket.

bypasssignaling.summary: Boolean flag (with &bypass); keeps routing SDP/ICE through the parent after RTC opens.

playbacktimer.summary: Position 1-9 (default 7; 0/false/off disables); shows a viewer playback-time overlay at that position.

dropdown.summary: Boolean flag; unhides the More Options dropButton chevron by clearing its classes.

compressed.summary: Boolean flag; enables SDP compression (marked WIP in code).

whepshare.summary: URL (prompts if empty); shares a WHEP source, filling the whepURL input and applying WHEP share settings.

autowhep.summary: Boolean flag; derives a WHEP share URL from the WHIP output URL and applies it.

whepsharetoken.summary: String token; auth token for the WHEP share source, applied only when WHIP output settings exist.

nosignal.summary: Pattern 1, 2/clean, 3/clock (0/false/off disables); shows a no-signal SVG wait image for absent video.

nomobilebitratecap.summary: Boolean flag; disables the mobile guest outbound bitrate cap.

maxmobilebitrate.summary: Numeric kbps (default 350); mobile guest outbound bitrate cap in normal conditions.

lowmobilebitrate.summary: Numeric kbps (default 35); mobile guest bitrate cap with more than 4 peers or old iOS Safari.

keepsw.summary: Boolean flag; skips unregistering existing service workers on load.

invite.summary: Encrypted string; AES-decrypts an invite link and applies its URL parameters.

preset.summary: Index or key (default 1); loads a parameter string from presets.json and merges it into the URL params.

fastmask.summary: Boolean flag; disables frame-locked segmentation for background effects.

accuratemask.summary: Boolean flag; forces frame-locked segmentation for background effects.

tfjsfacemesh.summary: Boolean flag; uses the legacy TFJS face mesh instead of the MediaPipe Face Landmarker.

codirectorinvitetemplate.summary: http(s) URL template with {room} and {codirector}; replaces the generated co-director invite URL.

tfliteeffects.summary: Boolean flag; skips both the MediaPipe selfie segmenter and the Longpipe effects pipeline, using the TFLite effects path.

nowheptrickle.summary: Boolean flag (or wheptrickle=0/false/off); disables ICE trickle on the managed Meshcast WHIP/WHEP gateway.

noaudiowhep.summary: Boolean flag; disables WHEP audio management for incoming WHEP sessions.

meshcast2screen.summary: String Publish Key; Meshcast account key used for screen-share publishing.

requireauth.summary: Same as &auth: requires sign-in before the session loads; also keeps the launcher hidden until auth resolves.

universaltoken.summary: Token string; turns on sign-in mode with a universal token, which lifts the sign-in requirement on view, scene and solo links.

fb.summary: Alias of &feedbackbutton: shows the hear-yourself button; optional value sets the self-monitor volume.

meshcast1.summary: Publishes through Meshcast server relay on first load; value picks the region (default any). Skipped when &meshcastfailed is present.

meshcastfailed.summary: Marker added after a Meshcast attempt fails; stops &meshcast and &meshcast1 from auto-starting on reload.

hangupbutton.summary: Alias &hub: shows the hang-up button in the control bar (boolean flag).

framegrab.summary: For non-directors, opens the Share Website tile pre-expanded for frame grabbing (boolean flag).

rightalign.summary: Alias of &alignright: aligns the video layout to the right; optional value.

translatelang.summary: Alias of &translate / &translationlanguage: sets the live caption translation language.

muteguest.summary: Member of the &audiogain family: starts received guest audio at gain 0 (muted).

ado.summary: Alias of &audiodevice: preselects the audio input by name, or 0 to disable audio.

reserveslots.summary: Alias of &slotreserve: reserves layout slots when slot mode is on.

bufferaudio.summary: Alias of &audiobuffer: viewer-side audio buffer target in ms.

connectionprofile.summary: Alias of &rtpprofile: RTP tuning profile, talkinghead or irl.

rcap.summary: Alias of &roomcap: caps how many guests the room admits.

buffer3.summary: Variant of &buffer: viewer playout buffer in ms; ignored on Chromium 51 to 77.

activespeakerfeatured.summary: Alias of &activehighlight: auto-features the loudest speaker as infocus (1) or infocus2 (2, default).

bgblur.summary: Alias of &backgroundblur: turns on background blur; optional strength value.

screenaudio.summary: &screenaudio=0 or false shares the screen without audio, same as &screensharevideoonly; hides the screen-audio option.

hideusermenu.summary: Aliases &nousermenu, &hum: hides the User options group in the settings panel.

perma.summary: With &room, keeps the "You are in room" header instead of switching it to the guest invite link.

wheptrickle.summary: &wheptrickle=0, false or off disables WHEP trickle ICE, same as &nowheptrickle.

authtoken.summary: Token string the sign-in redirect adds; turns on sign-in mode, is saved for the room, then is removed from the address bar.

slotslist.summary: Comma-separated slot numbers; limits processing to those slots. Ignored when &slots is also set.

holdercolor.summary: CSS color (a bare number gets a # prefix); background color of each video's holder. Defaults to the border color, then #000.

chunkbitrate.summary: Integer kbps, 1 to 100000; video bitrate for the chunked (WebCodecs) encoder, separate from the legacy &chunked value.

chunkfec.summary: Integer 0 to 12; forward error correction rate for chunked mode. Takes effect at 2 or more, which also forces indexed chunks.

chunknack.summary: Boolean (empty, 1 or true is on); keeps sent chunks so receivers can ask for lost ones again. Forces indexed chunks.

chunkindex.summary: Boolean; sends chunks with explicit indices (the indexed protocol). Forced on by &chunknack or &chunkfec of 2 or more.

chunkchunksize.summary: Integer bytes, 2048 to 65536 (default 16384); payload size of each chunk when NACK or FEC is on.

chunkretry.summary: Integer ms, 0 to 60000; minimum time sent chunks stay available for resend requests.

chunkcache.summary: Integer ms, 0 to 60000; fixed length of the resend cache, replacing the computed length (which tops out at 30 s).

chunkadaptfloor.summary: Integer kbps, 0 to 10000; lowest bitrate chunked-mode adaptation may fall to. Default is 20% of the base bitrate, at least 200.

chunkadaptceil.summary: Integer kbps, 0 to 100000; highest bitrate chunked-mode adaptation may rise to. Default is the base bitrate.

chunkadaptthreshold.summary: Number, 0 to 10000 (default 380); pressure level at which chunked-mode adaptation starts cutting bitrate or frames.

chunkadaptmaxdrop.summary: Integer 0 to 120 (default 6); cap on the frames chunked-mode adaptation may queue up to drop in framerate or hybrid mode.

chunkadaptinterval.summary: Integer ms, 100 to 60000 (default 800, floor 200); how often chunked-mode adaptation re-evaluates.

chunkadaptresolution.summary: Boolean; lets chunked-mode adaptation scale the encoded resolution down at low bitrates.

chunkbuffer.summary: Integer ms, 0 to 180000; playout buffer for chunked video on the receiving side.

chunkbufferfloor.summary: Integer ms, 0 to 180000; lower bound of the adaptive chunked playout buffer.

chunkbufferceil.summary: Integer ms, 0 to 180000; upper bound of the adaptive chunked playout buffer.

chunkbufferadaptive.summary: Boolean (default on); lets the chunked playout buffer size itself from network conditions. 0 or false fixes it, as &fixedchunkbuffer does.

chunkjitterslack.summary: Integer ms, 0 to 10000; extra allowance added to the chunked playout buffer for jitter.

chunknackattempts.summary: Integer 1 to 20 (default 3); how many times a receiver asks again for a missing chunk.

chunknackdelay.summary: Integer ms, 50 to 5000 (default 180); wait between requests for a missing chunk.

nomediapipe.summary: Boolean flag; skips the MediaPipe selfie segmenter. Unlike &forcetflite it leaves the Longpipe effects pipeline on.

longpipe.summary: Value 0, false or off turns the Longpipe background-effects pipeline off; any other value leaves it on.

nolongpipe.summary: Boolean flag; turns the Longpipe background-effects pipeline off, so effects use the older segmenters.

longpipepreset.summary: Preset name: xs, small, medium, large, xl, auto, or the shorthands fast, balanced and quality; picks the Longpipe segmentation model instead of the automatic choice.

longpipeauto.summary: Boolean flag; selects Longpipe's auto preset, the same as &longpipepreset=auto.

longpipeadaptive.summary: Boolean flag; turns on Longpipe's adaptive mode. Only applies with the auto preset.

nolongpipeadaptive.summary: Boolean flag; keeps Longpipe's adaptive mode off, overriding &longpipeadaptive.

longpipeoutput.summary: Output size cap for Longpipe effects: source or native, 4k or 2160, 1440 or 2k, 1080, 720, or WIDTHxHEIGHT. Default 1920x1080, or 1280x720 on mobile and slower devices.

longpipetemporal.summary: Mask smoothing mode for Longpipe: off (default), warp, or stabilized.

longpipedebug.summary: Boolean flag; turns on Longpipe's debug output.

icecast.summary: Flag; turns on Icecast audio publishing and works out the source from the link: local audio on a push link, received audio on a view link.

icecastpush.summary: Flag; publishes this page's own audio to an Icecast server.

icecastview.summary: Flag; publishes the audio this page receives to an Icecast server.

icecaststream.summary: Comma-separated stream IDs; which received streams feed the Icecast output. Falls back to the &view list.

icecasttarget.summary: Full Icecast source URL, mount included. Takes priority over &icecastserver with &icecastmount.

icecastserver.summary: Icecast server address; combined with &icecastmount to build the source URL.

icecastmount.summary: Icecast mount point; combined with &icecastserver to build the source URL.

icecastpass.summary: Icecast source password. Read from the link in place of the saved one.

icecastformat.summary: Audio format sent to Icecast, as a MIME type; default audio/aac.

icecastbitrate.summary: Icecast audio bitrate; a value under 1000 is read as kbps, otherwise bps. Default 128 kbps.

icecastrelay.summary: URL of the relay that forwards audio to Icecast, replacing the default relay; 0, false, off, no, direct or none sends without a relay. Podcast Studio reads it too.

icecastrelaytoken.summary: Access token sent to the Icecast relay. Podcast Studio reads it too.

icecastname.summary: Stream name shown in Icecast listings; default VDO.Ninja Live.

icecastgenre.summary: Stream genre shown in Icecast listings; default Live.

icecastdescription.summary: Stream description shown in Icecast listings.

icecastpublic.summary: Boolean; 0, false, off or no keeps the stream out of public Icecast directories, any other value lists it.

icecastauto.summary: Boolean; starts Icecast publishing on load once the settings are complete.

callinoutput.summary: Audio output device for call-in audio and the ringtone.

callinapi.summary: URL of the Twilio worker the call-in panel uses, replacing the default.

twiliotarget.summary: Phone number that pre-fills the Twilio outbound test field. &callintarget fills it too.

siptarget.summary: Dial target that pre-fills the SIP call-in panel, ahead of the saved profile. &callintarget fills it too.

callintarget.summary: Pre-fills the dial target in both the SIP and the Twilio call-in panels.

sipwss.summary: WebSocket address of the SIP server, ahead of the saved profile.

sipuri.summary: SIP URI to register as, ahead of the saved profile.

sipuser.summary: SIP auth username, ahead of the saved profile.

sipdisplay.summary: Display name sent on SIP calls, ahead of the saved profile; default VDO.Ninja.

sipregister.summary: Boolean (default on); whether the call-in panel registers with the SIP server.

sipautoanswer.summary: Boolean (default off); answers incoming SIP calls without a prompt.

sipauto.summary: Boolean; connects to the SIP or SignalWire server on load.

sipautodial.summary: Boolean; dials the pre-filled target once connected.

sippass.summary: Never used as a password: the call-in panel strips it from the address bar and ignores the value.

signalwirespace.summary: SignalWire space name; the scheme, path and .signalwire.com suffix are trimmed off.

podcast.summary: Flag; loads Podcast Studio on the main page and hides the director layout and control bar.

studioiso.summary: Boolean (default on); 0, false, off or no turns off Podcast Studio's record-to-disk controls.

novideobutton.summary: Disables the video button, so the guest cannot turn their camera off. Upstream's page summary for this parameter is a stray "What is new".
